variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: A union has called a strike in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by a union in the colony. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The colony has a union call for strike action. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
